name: Mirtazapine
summary: Mirtazapine is a depressant substance belonging to the Piperazinoazepine chemical class.

combinations.note: Uncertain or unpredictable interaction on PsychonautWiki.

pharmacology.text: Mirtazapine is sometimes described as a noradrenergic and specific serotonergic antidepressant (NaSSA). It is a tetracyclic piperazine-azepine. Mirtazapine has antihistamine, α2-blocker, and antiserotonergic activity. It is specifically a potent antagonist or inverse agonist of the α2A-, α2B-, and α2C-adrenergic receptors, the serotonin 5-HT2A, 5-HT2C, and the histamine H1 receptor.

uses.text: Mirtazapine, sold under the brand name Remeron among others, is an atypical tetracyclic antidepressant, and as such is used primarily to treat depression. It is often used in cases of depression complicated by anxiety or insomnia. The effectiveness of mirtazapine is comparable to other commonly prescribed antidepressants.

sideEffects.text: Common side effects include sleepiness, dizziness, increased appetite, and weight gain. Serious side effects may include mania, low white blood cell count, and increased suicide among children.
